name: Winch
description: Stamps _meta.winch onto tool calls, accepts HTTP wake webhooks, and reconciles assigned in-progress work.

dispatchEnabled.description: Accept wake webhooks and reconcile assigned in-progress work. Default true.

dispatchUrl.description: Winch HTTP base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:38291.

dispatchPublicBaseUrl.description: Gateway address winch can reach, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18789. Used to register the wake route.

dispatchHarness.description: Harness name registered in winch (must match WINCH_HARNESS). Default: openclaw.

dispatchStatePath.description: File holding the stable executor id and bearer (default: ~/.openclaw/state/winch-dispatch.json).

dispatchOpenclawBin.description: OpenClaw CLI entry used to start a wake session (default: the shim beside the gateway entry).
